wikipedia.noteJa: この記事はコハト（Kehath）本人を扱う。民数記26:58でアムラムの父として記される人物と照合できる。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.
